change: New rule :is(.menus-mount, .arow) .menu > button:not(.lbtn, .ibtn) with padding var(--ds-button-label-padding-block) var(--ds-button-label-padding-inline) (6px 12px). The general .menu > button:not(.lbtn, .ibtn) rule keeps var(--ds-space-075) var(--ds-space-100) (6px 8px).
states: Home, Invoice and Customer lists; Invoice, Customer, Geography and People records. Widths 360, 390, 480, 621, 640, 768, 900, 960, 1023, 1024, 1100, 1280 and 1440px, left to right and right to left. Touch below 1024px.
notes: The 16 unchanged readings from 768px up are the icon-only split-button caret in the Customer record heading (29 or 27 by 32px with a pointer, 44px on touch). It sits outside the command bars and keeps 6px 8px.

A first version applied 6px 12px to every .menu > button:not(.lbtn, .ibtn). It widened the account picture from 48px to 56px, which left the System Alerts menu 6px from the edge at 320px (tests/notifications-menu.spec.mjs, mobile-touch and mobile-rtl), and shifted the email Move to button (tests/messaging.spec.mjs email-reading.png). The rule was narrowed to the command bars.
